answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance across diverse tasks spanning myriad domains.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning paths for multimodal mathematical problems, including step-by-step solutions and final answers, using synthetic data and verification methods.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of MM-Verifier, MM-Reasoner, and the baselines on two commonly used benchmarks: MathVista and MathVerse.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-08-06) to verify ⟨q i , p i j ⟩ using the instruction "Verify step by step..."

answer_4.quote: our MM-Verifier-7B outperforms Qwen2-VL-72B across all metrics on the MathVista and MathVerse benchmarks
answer_4.guideline: The paper compares model performance against human performance on the MathVista benchmark, indicating human evaluation was conducted.
